        out.close();
        scanner.close();

    static class TaskA {
        public void solve(int testNumber, java.util.Scanner in, PrintWriter out) {
            int testCount = 1;
            while (true) {
                int n = in.nextInt();
                int D = in.nextInt();
                if (n == 0 && D == 0) break;
                out.println("@" + testCount++);
                final double r = 1;
                Point pl = new Point(-D, 0);
                Point pr = new Point(+D, 0);
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {

                        pl = pl.add(v);
                        pr = pr.add(v);
                        continue;
                    }
                    double x = D * (vl + vr) / (vl - vr);
                    Point o = pl.add(pr).scale(0.5);
                    Point ox = o.add(pr.sub(o).norm().scale(x));
                    Point nl = pl.sub(ox);

        class Point {
